principle: Keep this catalog small. The model/manager selects the smallest relevant contract pack from metadata, then loads only that registry. Deterministic code must not keyword-route literary intent on the model's behalf.

packs.description: Reader reaction/comparison, character integrity, revision diagnosis, long-horizon narrative interpretation, reader expectations, memory consolidation, and adaptive-learning semantic analysis/evaluation.
packs.load_when: The task needs quality diagnosis, reader/character evaluation, derived narrative interpretation, memory consolidation, or learning evaluation.

packs.description: Sparse semantic context selection and model-owned Corpus discovery/query planning under deterministic budget, capability and rights guards.
packs.load_when: The task must choose which memory/context blocks matter now or plan evidence searches for a Corpus/research gap.

packs.description: Goal- and knowledge-bounded character action simulation followed by scene-level collision/world-state resolution and causal event trajectory proposals.
packs.load_when: The task is pre-draft scene simulation, character agency simulation, or repair of a flat/forced scene through causal character/world interactions.

packs.description: Dynamic active-plan reconciliation, evidence-based relationship-memory reconciliation, and explicit narrative-commitment auditing for long-horizon coherence.
packs.load_when: The task must adapt a plan after causal emergence, reconcile conflicting long-lived relationship memories, or verify a candidate against explicit long-term commitments/facts.
